label: Connecticut Wing
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3.25 in (wings 3.25 in, as patch-new-york-wing); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions
provenance: Unit emblem of Connecticut Wing (NER-CT-001), digital artwork supplied by Ethan Hillard on 2026-11-10. Official digital artwork shipped as given: webp (VP8L lossless) -> png via dwebp; the file came without transparency on a plain white ground: the white outside the emblem's own outline was made transparent (connected from the image border, white at 238 or more of 255; 131383 px) and the 2339 edge pixels blended with that white were given their coverage as alpha; then trimmed to its alpha bounding box (554 x 554 px to 504 x 495 px), no resampling, no colour change.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only change is the white ground outside the outline, made transparent so the emblem sits on the garment.
